basis: Existing species-level reference dimensions were reclassified uniformly; representative values are approximate and are not a uniform set of maximum lengths or measurements of the player's individual. Body length, carapace length/width, disc width, bell diameter and arm span differ. The listed 10 environment entries remain outside the animal size bands.

selected_checks.note: FishBase reports a maximum of 15cm standard length; the game uses 14cm as an approximate reference.
Enoshima Aquarium describes roughly 1m when grown.
NOAA notes adults can reach nearly 10 feet; the game does not claim 2.5m is a maximum or universal adult size.
NOAA gives up to 32 feet; the game uses a smaller 6m reference, not a maximum.
NOAA gives about 40ft/12.2m in this identification guide.
NOAA describes blue whales up to about 31m; the game uses a 25m reference, not a maximum.
300cm is the approximate span of extended legs, not carapace width.
20cm refers to bell diameter; SeaLifeBase's extracted maximum differs.
60cm refers to total length including arms; some databases instead give mantle length.
